name: io.github.detongz/alauda-home-equity
title: Alauda Home Equity
description: Estimate home equity, compare borrowing options and look up HELOC rates and lender terms.

tools.name: estimate_home_equity
tools.description: Use this when a homeowner asks how much they could borrow against their home, how much equity they have, or how their figures compare with lenders' published limits. Do not use for purchase mortgages, refinancing a first mortgage, rent-versus-buy, credit card questions or general rate news. Amounts are US dollars. Room is shown under combined loan-to-value (CLTV) limits that lenders commonly publish, before any lender fee; what a homeowner can borrow is the lender's decision. Results are estimates from the homeowner's own figures, not a quote, an offer or an approval; an input left out stays unknown, never zero. Lender and rate data cover California and Florida. Alauda runs this tool and it is free for homeowners; when a homeowner applies through our licensed mortgage partner, the lender pays that partner and the partner pays Alauda.

state.description: Two-letter code of the US state the home is in, for example CA.

home_value_estimate.description: The homeowner's estimate of the home's value, in US dollars.

first_mortgage_balance.description: What is still owed on the first mortgage, in US dollars; 0 when the home is owned free and clear.

other_liens.description: Balances of any other loans secured by the home (a second mortgage or an existing HELOC), in US dollars; 0 when there are none. Leave out when unknown.

credit_band.description: The homeowner's own credit range: excellent 740+, good 670-739, fair 580-669, poor under 580. Leave out when unknown.

amount_wanted.description: The cash the homeowner wants to receive, in US dollars. Leave out when unknown.

scenario_token.description: The scenario_token of an earlier result in this conversation, as returned. It fills any answer not sent here; an answer sent here wins.

tools.name: compare_home_equity_products
tools.description: Use this when a homeowner asks which kind of home equity product to consider (a HELOC, a home equity loan, a home equity investment or a reverse mortgage) or how they compare for their situation. Do not use for purchase mortgages, refinancing a first mortgage, rent-versus-buy, credit card questions or general rate news. Amounts are US dollars; rate ranges are percent APRs from lenders' advertised rates; costs are interest plus fees over the time horizon. Home equity investments and reverse mortgages are explained, not priced. Each product is checked against published lender rules and the homeowner's stated preferences: estimates, not quotes, offers, approvals or a recommendation. Lender and rate data cover California and Florida. Alauda runs this tool and it is free for homeowners; when a homeowner applies through our licensed mortgage partner, the lender pays that partner and the partner pays Alauda.

state.description: Two-letter code of the US state the home is in, for example CA.

home_value_estimate.description: The homeowner's estimate of the home's value, in US dollars.

first_mortgage_balance.description: What is still owed on the first mortgage, in US dollars; 0 when the home is owned free and clear.

other_liens.description: Balances of any other loans secured by the home (a second mortgage or an existing HELOC), in US dollars; 0 when there are none. Leave out when unknown.

credit_band.description: The homeowner's own credit range: excellent 740+, good 670-739, fair 580-669, poor under 580. Leave out when unknown.

purpose.description: What the money is for. debt_consolidation also prices the cost of not borrowing. Leave out when unstated.

amount_wanted.description: The cash the homeowner wants to receive, in US dollars. Leave out when unknown.

horizon_months.description: How long the homeowner expects to keep the loan, in months (12-360).

draw_pattern.description: lump_sum: all the money at closing. staged: drawn over time, as a HELOC allows.

rate_preference.description: fixed: a payment that stays the same. either: no rate type stated.

current_first_mortgage_rate.description: The first mortgage's annual rate in percent, for example 3.25.

scenario_token.description: The scenario_token of an earlier result in this conversation, as returned. It fills any answer not sent here; an answer sent here wins.

tools.name: lookup_home_equity_rate_ranges
tools.description: Use this when a homeowner asks what HELOC or home equity loan rates lenders advertise now in their state. Do not use for purchase mortgages, refinancing a first mortgage, rent-versus-buy, credit card questions or general rate news. Rates are percent APRs: low, typical (median) and high across lenders' own advertised rates in our catalog, with dates and source pages. Ranges are market context, not a quote: a lender prices each borrower. Lender and rate data cover California and Florida. Alauda runs this tool and it is free for homeowners; when a homeowner applies through our licensed mortgage partner, the lender pays that partner and the partner pays Alauda.

state.description: Two-letter code of the US state the home is in, for example CA.

product.description: heloc: a line of credit. home_equity_loan: one lump sum at a fixed rate.

credit_band.description: The homeowner's own credit range: excellent 740+, good 670-739, fair 580-669, poor under 580. Leave out when unknown.

tools.name: search_home_equity_lenders
tools.description: Use this when a homeowner asks which lenders offer a HELOC or home equity loan in their state, or wants lenders sorted by rate, upfront fees, time to money or name. Do not use for purchase mortgages, refinancing a first mortgage, rent-versus-buy, credit card questions or general rate news. Returns named lenders, including lenders that pay Alauda nothing, each with its rate in percent (advertised, or a category estimate where the lender publishes none), fees in US dollars or percent, usual days to money and source page. Rows are sorted only by the criterion chosen; they are not quotes or offers. Lender and rate data cover California and Florida. Alauda runs this tool and it is free for homeowners; when a homeowner applies through our licensed mortgage partner, the lender pays that partner and the partner pays Alauda.

state.description: Two-letter code of the US state the home is in, for example CA.

product.description: heloc: a line of credit. home_equity_loan: one lump sum at a fixed rate.

sort_by.description: The order the homeowner asked for. lowest_upfront_fees needs amount_wanted, since some fees are a percentage and some a flat dollar figure.

amount_wanted.description: The cash the homeowner wants to receive, in US dollars. Leave out when unknown.

limit.description: Most rows to return, 1-5 (default 5); fewer come back when they would not fit, and next_offset continues the list.

offset.description: Rows to skip: pass next_offset from the last result to see more (default 0).

tools.name: project_home_equity_costs
tools.description: Use this when a homeowner wants the monthly payment or total interest for an amount, rate and term, or to compare up to four what-ifs (another amount, rate or term, or a rate rise). Do not use for purchase mortgages, refinancing a first mortgage, rent-versus-buy, credit card questions or general rate news. Amounts are US dollars and rates annual percent; any interest-only period comes first, then equal monthly payments of principal and interest. This is arithmetic on the figures given, not a lender's offer, and no APR is computed. Alauda runs this tool and it is free for homeowners; when a homeowner applies through our licensed mortgage partner, the lender pays that partner and the partner pays Alauda.

product_type.description: heloc: a line of credit. home_equity_loan: one lump sum at a fixed rate.

annual_interest_rate_percent.description: The annual interest rate in percent, for example 7.5.

repayment_months.description: Months of equal principal-and-interest payments, after any interest-only period.

interest_only_months.description: Months of interest-only payments first, as in a HELOC's draw period (default 0).

fees.description: One-time fees in US dollars, paid once and not financed. Leave out when unknown.

stress_rate_percent.description: A higher annual rate in percent to test, for example after a variable rate rises.

scenarios.description: One to four loans to project.

tools.name: explain_home_equity
tools.description: Use this when a homeowner asks how a HELOC works, how it differs from a home equity loan, what documents lenders ask for, how long it takes, how a reverse mortgage or home equity investment works, or whether a rate or fees they were quoted, or a rate they saw, look typical. Do not use for purchase mortgages, refinancing a first mortgage, rent-versus-buy, credit card questions or general rate news. Explanations are general information. For quoted terms, the rate (percent) and fees (US dollars) are set against the advertised range for the state and product. Not advice on a specific loan, and not an offer. Lender and rate data cover California and Florida. Alauda runs this tool and it is free for homeowners; when a homeowner applies through our licensed mortgage partner, the lender pays that partner and the partner pays Alauda.

topic.description: What to explain. evaluate_quoted_terms checks a quote against advertised rates; give state, quoted_product and quoted_rate_percent.

state.description: Two-letter code of the US state the home is in, for example CA.

quoted_product.description: heloc: a line of credit. home_equity_loan: one lump sum at a fixed rate.

quoted_rate_percent.description: The rate the lender quoted, annual percent.

quoted_fees_usd.description: The one-time fees the lender quoted, in US dollars.

quoted_amount_usd.description: The loan amount the quote is for, in US dollars.

tools.name: get_continue_link
tools.description: Use this when the homeowner wants to go further: save what they told you, apply, or talk to a loan officer. Do not use for purchase mortgages, refinancing a first mortgage, rent-versus-buy, credit card questions or general rate news. Builds a link to Alauda's site with the answers given here or in scenario_token filled in, in US dollars as sent; never a street address, contact details or SSN. The link works for 30 minutes, and nothing is saved until the homeowner continues on that page. Give continue_url exactly as returned. For a home in a state Alauda does not cover yet there is no link to continue: waitlist_url instead, carrying no answers. Alauda runs this tool and it is free for homeowners; when a homeowner applies through our licensed mortgage partner, the lender pays that partner and the partner pays Alauda.
